description: Find domain names from a free-text idea, brand or phrase; a phrase yields short combinations of its words. top_picks answers "how does my name look": the name as typed (when its extension isn't .com/.net/.org) and the name on .com, .net and .org, or on each extension in tlds, with its real status, taken and unknown included, as check_domain reports it. suggestions are up to `limit` ranked names a live check found available, never repeating a top pick, with per-year prices in USD, premium names included unless include_premium is false; match is exact_sld or variation, and hack is true for a domain hack such as danger.zone. unchecked_names lists names whose check came back unknown, left_out counts why other names checked aren't suggested, and with tlds, each extension says why it found nothing. Search is advisory: confirm the chosen name with check_domain before quoting it, and a purchase checks again. Read-only, no side effects.

include_premium.description: false leaves premium names out of the suggestions (default true).

max_price.description: Leave out suggestions whose first_term.total, the first term's price with the ICANN fee (what buying it costs), is above this USD amount, e.g. "25.00".

query.description: Free-text seed, e.g. "learning studio app", a bare SLD, or a full domain.

tlds.description: Optional TLDs to restrict the search to, e.g. ["com", "app", "io"]. The name on each becomes a top pick.

name: search_domains

left_out.description: How many checked candidates aren't suggestions, by reason, so a short list explains itself: over_limit (past limit), over_max_price, premium (include_premium is false), premium_over_cap (above the purchase cap), price_unconfirmed (the registry's price didn't arrive), unchecked (no answer) and unavailable (taken or reserved).

suggestions.description: Available names, never one of the top picks.

items.description: One name's availability and per-year price, shared by GET /domains/check and GET /domains/search. `rank`, `hack` and `match` appear on search suggestions only; `reason` only when the name isn't available.

available.description: null when the registry could not be asked (degraded availability).

first_term.description: Available names: the shortest term the request allows (years or min_years) and its total, the ICANN fee included. A purchase's max_price taken from it always covers it.

total.description: An amount as a decimal string, never a float, with its ISO 4217 currency. Ledger amounts are signed.

hack.description: True when the name is a domain hack, e.g. danger.zone (search only).

icann_fee.description: Same shape as Money, or null when there is no amount.

match.description: exact_sld: the SLD as searched; variation: a stem or a hack (search only).

min_years.description: Smallest purchase term; prices are per year.

pricing_source.description: registry: priced live for this name. baseline: the extension's standard rate, and final for this name: the extension has no premium names (premium_possible is false in GET /pricing/{tld}), or the registry's live check returned no premium price for it. unconfirmed: the registry lookup didn't finish, so on an extension with premium names the price isn't final. A purchase checks the price again either way. Describes REGISTRATION only; see pricing_sources for the others.

purchasable.description: Available and buyable here now; a purchase still re-checks.

purchase_blocker.description: Why a name isn't purchasable: premium_over_cap (a premium above the $10,000 cap), price_unconfirmed (the registry didn't confirm the price), availability_unknown (available is null: the registry couldn't be asked, so check again). null when purchasable, and when available is false, where reason says why.

reason.description: Only when available is false or null. unavailable: the registry won't offer it (or said why in words we don't map); unknown: the check failed or was shed, so try again. This set won't grow.

tlds.description: With tlds, one entry per extension asked for, in that order; null without it.

found.description: Available names on it that pass max_price and include_premium, top picks included.

reason.description: Why found is 0, null otherwise: unsupported (not sold here), over_max_price (its standard first term is above max_price, or every available name on it was), not_searched (the search's bounded pool ran out first), or the left_out reason that kept its names out, the first that applies in left_out's order.
